text_block_list.text:
A few days had passed since the Shuka Sho. 
During that time, as for Mejiro Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
—Aah, how gorgeous...! Please strike a 
different pose next!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Filming Crew
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaaaahhh!!

...As for Mejiro Ramonu, she was spending 
her days swamped with an eruption of 
interview requests.
choice_data_list:
(I have been holding back on interviews 
until now, after all.)

text_block_list.text:
In accordance with Mejiro Ramonu's wish to 
focus on training and races, she had 
generally refused interviews that took up 
large amounts of time.
However, this time—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I gladly accept.

Overwhelmed by the flood of press 
inquiries, I went to consult Mejiro 
Ramonu... and that was her nonchalant 
reply.
choice_data_list: ...Everything?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Everything.

...It seems she has no intention of saying 
more. Perhaps it's because having cleared 
her major goal, she finally has some free 
time to spare...

"Or perhaps to whip the fans into an even 
greater frenzy and stage the 'supreme 
race'... She might have such intentions in 
mind."

text_block_list.name: Filming Crew
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's all for today! Thank you very 
much!”
choice_data_list: Ah, thank you for your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.
choice_data_list:
(I want to talk about the next target race 
too, but...)

text_block_list.text:
With all the hustle and bustle, I haven't 
had time to sit down and talk with her 
properly. Even today, her schedule is 
packed with interviews right after this.
choice_data_list:
Next time... I'll be running with Symboli 
Rudolf again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Again?
choice_data_list:
It was pretty much the same the day before 
yesterday, right?

It was pretty much the same the day before 
yesterday, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Huh...

...Though Mejiro Ramonu couldn't care 
less, she has many joint interviews with 
Symboli Rudolf lined up ahead. The reason 
being—

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"—Ah, truly wonderful as expected...! The 
'Emperor' Symboli Rudolf and..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Standing alongside "Miss Perfect" Mejiro 
Ramonu! It's truly ideal...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, when you say it with such passion, 
it's a little embarrassing."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"We want to see the two of them together!" 
We've received so many passionate 
requests... I mean, SO many! They've been 
flooding in!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's truly like a dream... Though it 
is a shame Symboli Rudolf has already 
stepped back from the front lines.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry I couldn't meet your 
expectations. However, this is so that I 
can move on to my next dream.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware! The two who carved out a 
new era of racing history... I would love 
to see them standing side by side as 
symbols of even greater progress.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...That is a future we would welcome with 
open arms, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Please keep it close to your heart purely 
as an ideal. Now then, let us begin the 
interview."
And so, amidst these hectic days—
That message came far too suddenly.
choice_data_list: A job managing the URA, for me...?
A job managing the URA, for me...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. URA Headquarters contacted the 
academy specifically requesting you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Counting on the ability of both Ms. Mejiro 
Ramonu and the Trainer who achieved such 
great results with her—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"They want to entrust you with work that 
will lead to the future development of the 
racing world."

"Work that contributes to the development 
of the racing world"... As someone who 
loves racing, it's a dream opportunity. 
However...
choice_data_list:
I have my race against Ramonu coming up, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Regarding that, there's something else 
I'd like to discuss."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Actually...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
âThere are rumors that Ramon-san will be 
stepping down from the front lines.
choice_data_list: ...Yes?

text_block_list.text:
...It took me a moment to swallow the 
meaning of those words. I hadn't heard 
anything like that from Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't their own opinion, but rather a 
proposal that came up within the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As you know, Trainer, the Mejiro family, 
alongside the Symboli family, has devoted 
themselves to the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Their sworn ally, Symboli Rudolf of the 
Symboli family, has stepped down from the 
front lines to work for the future..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"If so, as the Mejiro family, what if we 
propose that Mejiro Ramonu stand by her 
side and help shape the future from the 
same perspective?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"A flawless Mejiro Ramonu is truly worthy 
of shouldering our future." —Word like 
that seems to be spreading.
choice_data_list:
I see... So that's why you came to talk to 
me.

I see... So that's why you came to talk to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems someone assumed Mejiro 
Ramonu-san would retire and made an early 
move to secure a Trainer.
choice_data_list:
And what will Ramonu think of that 
proposal?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I believe she's already been approached 
about it.

Mejiro Ramonu didn't show the slightest 
hint of it. The reason for that, 
naturally, was singular—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
As long as this love demands it, I will 
simply keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The academy will leave the decision 
entirely up to you, Trainer. Please take 
it back with you and take all the time you 
need to think it over.
choice_data_list: ...Please wait, I—
...Please wait, I'm—

text_block_list.text:
Returning to the trainer's office, I sat 
thinking for a while, when—

Mejiro Ramonu came to visit. It's very 
unusual for her to come here, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: And so... What will you do?

It seems word of the URA's inquiry had 
already reached her ears.

What to do from here on out... The answer 
was already decided long ago. Because I 
already knew what she would do.
choice_data_list: Nothing's going to change.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?
choice_data_list: I'll keep loving both you and racing.
I will continue to love you and racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If that's what I am, then you are too, 
after all..."
choice_data_list: That's why we need a strategy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Please tell me.
choice_data_list:
Just shaking them off will only buy you 
time

text_block_list.text:
The demands from the Mejiro family and the 
Academy were proof of just how exceptional 
an Umamusume Mejiro Ramonu was. She, too, 
understood her own responsibilities.
choice_data_list:
I want to secure a future where you can 
keep running.

text_block_list.text:
To convince them that this isn't mere ego, 
but leads to the creation of the future 
everyone desires... by delivering results 
that far surpass expectations.
choice_data_list:
Prove that your running is the future 
itself.

I'll prove that your running itself is the 
future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...That's a passing grade, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "If it is a strategy, it is quite simple."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: We simply need to drag Rudolf out.
choice_data_list: Symboli Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It all started with that person, didn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Since she is stepping down, I should step 
down too... and together we should build 
the future, you say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you simply need to stand 
beside her on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to run there will lead to even 
further growth...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Run a race so supreme that everyone 
kneels before it. You need only prove it 
so.
choice_data_list: If we use the senior class...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Then, would you care to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"A race rotation leading toward the 
supreme race."

Mejiro Ramonu gazes steadily at me. It 
seems she's leaving it up to my 
discretion...!
choice_data_list: Are you sure?
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You are a Trainer, aren't you?
choice_data_list: Alright, give me a little time!
Alright, give me a little time, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Go ahead, begin.
choice_data_list:
First, I'd like to advance to the Victoria 
Mile.

text_block_list.text:
A Senior Class mile race featuring many 
girls who battled fiercely along the Tiara 
route. It will determine the Umamusume 
worthy of being top of the mile division.

It's the perfect opportunity to show off 
Mejiro Ramonu's strength in the mile and 
reaffirm her presence.
choice_data_list: And after that, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix race of the west, the 
Takarazuka Kinen, draws highly popular 
Umamusume across various divisions. The 
competition will be completely different 
from before...

Yet even amidst this clash of rivals, 
Mejiro Ramonu will surely run flawlessly. 
Such exceptional talent is said to be 
exceedingly rare.
choice_data_list: And the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.text:
Here, too, horse girls from the Tiara 
route compete for grace and prestige. A 
victory here would further elevate the 
Mejiro family's renown—

By continuing to run, Mejiro Ramonu can 
demonstrate that her mission is being 
fulfilled. She will become queen of both 
the mile and middle distances.
choice_data_list:
And the schedule is coming up close, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Please go on.
choice_data_list: Lastly—I want to advance to the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.text:
As an international race where the 
strongest Umamusume gather, I have watched 
over this race countless times with hope 
and joy.
choice_data_list:
Truly a stage worthy of the final 
showdown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And that is where we will invite Rudolph, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"If we unfold the supreme race... we can 
rewrite our ideals."
choice_data_list: Love will surely surpass our ideals!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. Without fail...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for your hard work. That was 
truly splendid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Along the path to the summit... let us 
run."

And so, it was decided that I would 
continue running with Mejiro Ramonu 
through the Senior year. First up is the 
"Victoria Mile"—
